The freeze_position for gripped_object:cube_3 is invalid at this stage because the subtask only requires the gripper (not cube_3) position/orientation to be fixed; cube_3 should be released, not frozen.
Reasoning: This subtask requires (1) maintaining both the position and orientation of the robot's tool frame (panda_fingertip) fixed in the world frame, (2) commanding the gripper to fully open, and (3) stopping when the gripper is open and cube_3 is no longer held (implied by lack of resistive forces/effort). The conflicting freeze_position on cube_3 (which cannot be both gripped and released with the gripper fully opened) is removed to comply with the TermAPI and the subtask semantics.
